description: MfE Data Service is a data repository run by Ministry for the Environment, New Zealand. The Koordinates-based service offers environmental and land layers of the ministry, including coastal-hazard, flood, land-cover and climate-projection data, with web services and downloads. Coverage: New Zealand. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as gpkg, shp, geotiff, wms; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("MfE Data Service") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support coastal and flood exposure studies of New Zealand infrastructure. Related records: data-nz-mfe-115976, data-nz-mfe-52585 are catalogued from the same site.
